title: Longest substring with distinct characters

problem.name: Longest substring with distinct characters
problem.statement_latex: Given $S\in\Sigma^n$, find a longest contiguous interval in which all characters are pairwise distinct. Complexity uses indexed characters and coherent data-structure operations.
